v.t: We sent Noah to his people: “Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment.”
v.l: Inna 'Arsalna Nuhaan 'Ila Qawmihi 'An 'Andhir Qawmaka Min Qabli 'An Ya'tiyahum `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: He said, “O my people, I am to you a clear warner
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi 'Inni Lakum Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: Worship God and reverence Him, and obey me
v.l: Ani A`budu Allaha Wa Attaquhu Wa 'Ati`uni

v.t: And He will forgive you of your sins, and reprieve you until a stated term. God’s term cannot be deferred once it has arrived, if you only knew.”
v.l: Yaghfir Lakum Min Dhunubikum Wa Yu'uakhkhirkum 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan 'Inna 'Ajala Allahi 'Idha Ja'a La Yu'uakhkharu Law Kuntum Ta`lamuna

v.t: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day
v.l: Qala Rabbi 'Inni Da`awtu Qawmi Laylaan Wa Naharaan

v.t: But my call added only to their flight
v.l: Falam Yazid/hum Du`a'i 'Illa Firaraan

v.t: Whenever I called them to Your forgiveness, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves in their garments, and insisted, and became more and more arrogant
v.l: Wa 'Inni Kullama Da`awtuhum Litaghfira Lahum Ja`alu 'Asabi`ahum Fi 'Adhanihim Wa Astaghshaw Thiyabahum Wa 'Asarru Wa Astakbaru Astikbaraan

v.t: Then I called them openly
v.l: Thumma 'Inni Da`awtuhum Jiharaan

v.t: Then I appealed to them publicly, and I spoke to them privately
v.l: Thumma 'Inni 'A`lantu Lahum Wa 'Asrartu Lahum 'Israraan

v.t: I said, ‘Ask your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving
v.l: Faqultu Astaghfiru Rabbakum 'Innahu Kana Ghaffaraan

v.t: He will let loose the sky upon you in torrents
v.l: Yursili As-Sama'a `Alaykum Midraraan

v.t: And provide you with wealth and children, and allot for you gardens, and allot for you rivers
v.l: Wa Yumdidkum Bi'amwalin Wa Banina Wa Yaj`al Lakum Jannatin Wa Yaj`al Lakum 'Anharaan

v.t: What is the matter with you, that you do not appreciate God’s Greatness
v.l: Ma Lakum La Tarjuna Lillahi Waqaraan

v.t: Although He created you in stages
v.l: Wa Qad Khalaqakum 'Atwaraan

v.t: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers
v.l: Alam Taraw Kayfa Khalaqa Allahu Sab`a Samawatin Tibaqaan

v.t: And He set the moon in their midst for light, and He made the sun a lamp
v.l: Wa Ja`ala Al-Qamara Fihinna Nuraan Wa Ja`ala Ash-Shamsa Sirajaan

v.t: And God germinated you from the earth like plants
v.l: Wa Allahu 'Anbatakum Mina Al-'Arđi Nabataan

v.t: Then He will return you into it, and will bring you out again
v.l: Thumma Yu`idukum Fiha Wa Yukhrijukum 'Ikhrajaan

v.t: And God made the earth a spread for you
v.l: Wa Allahu Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'Arđa Bisataan

v.t: That you may travel its diverse roads.’”
v.l: Litasluku Minha Subulaan Fijajaan

v.t: Noah said, “My Lord, they have defied me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition.”
v.l: Qala Nuhun Rabbi 'Innahum `Asawni Wa Attaba`u Man Lam Yazid/hu Maluhu Wa Waladuhu 'Illa Khasaraan

v.t: And they schemed outrageous schemes
v.l: Wa Makaru Makraan Kubbaraan

v.t: And they said, “Do not give up your gods; do not give up Wadd, nor Souwa, nor Yaghoos, and Yaooq, and Nassr
v.l: Wa Qalu La Tadharunna 'Alihatakum Wa La Tadharunna Waddaan Wa La Suwa`aan Wa La Yaghutha Wa Ya`uqa Wa Nasraan

v.t: They have misled many, so do not increase the wrongdoers except in confusion.”
v.l: Wa Qad 'Ađallu Kathiraan Wa La Tazidi Az-Zalimina 'Illa Đalalaan

v.t: Because of their wrongs, they were drowned, and were hurled into a Fire. They did not find apart from God any helpers
v.l: Mimma Khati'atihim 'Ughriqu Fa'udkhilu Naraan Falam Yajidu Lahum Min Duni Allahi 'Ansaraan

v.t: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth
v.l: Wa Qala Nuhun Rabbi La Tadhar `Ala Al-'Arđi Mina Al-Kafirina Dayyaraan

v.t: If You leave them, they will mislead your servants, and will breed only wicked unbelievers
v.l: Innaka 'In Tadharhum Yuđillu `Ibadaka Wa La Yalidu 'Illa Fajiraan Kaffaraan

v.t: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home in faith, and all the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the wrongdoers except in perdition.”
v.l: Rabbi Aghfir Li Wa Liwalidayya Wa Liman Dakhala Baytiya Mu'uminaan Wa Lilmu'uminina Wa Al-Mu'uminati Wa La Tazidi Az-Zalimina 'Illa Tabaraan
